test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ‘Flights’, a novel about travel in the 21st century and human anatomy is written by which of the following Booker prize winner (2018) writers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Olga Tokarczuk**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'Flights’, a novel about travel in the 21st century and human anatomy is written by **Olga Tokarczuk**.
 
• Polish author **Olga Tokarczuk **and translator** Jennifer Croft** discuss Tokarczuk’s Flights, winner of the 2018 Man Booker International Prize.
 
• Her **works** include Primeval and Other Times, Drive Your Plow Over the Bones of the Dead, and The Books of Jacob.
 
• Tokarczuk is noted for the **mythical tone** of her writing.
 
• For **Flights and The Books of Jacob**, she won the Nike Awards, Poland's top literary prize, among other accolades; she also won five times Nike audience award.
 
• Her works have been translated into almost **40 languages**, making her one of the most translated contemporary Polish writers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Taslima Nasrin** is a Bangladeshi-Swedish writer, physician, feminist, secular humanist, and activist. She is known for her writing on women's oppression and criticism of religion.
 
• Suzanna **Arundhati Roy** is an Indian author best known for her novel The God of Small Things, which won the Man Booker Prize for Fiction in 1997 and became the best-selling book by a non-expatriate Indian author. 
 
• **Virginie Despentes** is a French writer, novelist, and filmmaker. She is known for her work exploring gender, sexuality, and people who live in poverty or other marginalised conditions.
